A new Slayer. A new Sunnydale. And the rumored return of Sarah Michelle Gellar?

On paper, the Buffy the Vampire Slayer revival had everything it needed to be a massive hit. Nostalgia, a built-in fanbase, and a fresh direction for a new generation. So what went wrong?

Before the new series could even premiere, it was quietly scrapped, leaving behind a leaked pilot script, behind-the-scenes rumors, and a lot of unanswered questions.

Was it creative differences? Studio interference? Or did the reboot simply miss what made Buffy special in the first place?

From early development to sudden cancellation, this is the story of the Buffy revival that never was… and why it may have been doomed from the start.
